leverage.exposure: No leverage is open right now - the balance is positive and the unwind from the previous cycle completed. The recommended move deliberately opens one: from the moment the Tanaka auction settles on Friday morning until Conte is sold, the balance is negative, and a negative balance when MD3 starts scores zero for the entire matchday. That window is about ten hours wide and closes at the lock. This is the honest trade-off to weigh: the upgrade is worth a few percent of the eleven's expected points, and botching the unwind costs all of them. If Georg cannot be sure he will be at his phone between the auction resolving and the lock, the correct action is to remove the offer entirely and field the current shape with no exposure at all.

binding_gap: The binding constraint is cash, not the spending floor. The floor would permit a large purchase; the rule that a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the whole matchday does not, and with cash this low every buy has to be funded by a sale that can only be made after the buy lands. That caps a single purchase at roughly what the Conte sale returns, which is why the best player on the board is unreachable and a Schalke midfielder on one good match is the best available move.

verdict.detail: One thing matters this cycle and it is already half-done wrong: the live offer on Satoshi Tanaka is sitting at exactly his market value, well below the price this ledger called for. Raise it before the auction resolves on Friday morning, or pull it. Leaving it where it is buys the full downside risk at a reduced chance of the upside, which is the worst of the three available choices. Nothing else on the board is both affordable and an improvement, so this is the whole run.

sell.reason: Conte is the funding leg and nothing more. He is fit, he is in Hoffenheim's dated projected eleven at home to Stuttgart, and he is sold only because he is the cheapest asset that pays for a genuine upgrade elsewhere. The order is not negotiable: he goes only AFTER Tanaka lands. Selling him first drops the squad to ten and the penalty costs more than his own scoring. Selling him to Kickbase at market value is a single action that takes seconds, so the unwind fits easily inside the window between the auction resolving and the lock - but it has to actually happen inside it.
